exclusions.source_text: Serum creatinine ≤1.5 x ULN or estimated glomerular filtration rate (GFR) ≥45 mL/min using Cockcroft Gault formula.
exclusions.threshold: creatinine ≤1.5 x ULN or GFR ≥45 mL/min

exclusions.source_text: Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤2.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN); if liver metastases, then ≤5 x ULN
exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT ≤2.5 x ULN; ≤5 x ULN if liver metastases

exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin ≤1.5 x ULN; if liver metastases or metabolic disorder such as Gilbert's syndrome, then ≤2.5 x ULN.
exclusions.threshold: bilirubin ≤1.5 x ULN; ≤2.5 x ULN if liver metastases

exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 1.
Patients must not be undergoing treatment for a second active cancer at the time of randomization.
Patients with HIV may enroll, but must have an undetectable viral load at the time of enrollment and must be receiving a stable regimen of HAART.
Patients must not have known, symptomatic brain or leptomeningeal metastases.
Female participant has a negative serum pregnancy test within 24 hours prior to taking study treatment if of childbearing potential
For fertile patient (female able to become pregnant or male able to father a child), refusal to use effective contraception during the period of the trial
